text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both up modestly over 24 hours with BTC at $77,420 and ETH at $2,476, signaling mild upward momentum without conviction. Altcoins like SOL and BNB are outpacing the majors, suggesting traders are rotating into riskier positions while the market settles in the Greed zone at 56 on the Fear & Greed index. Bitcoin dominance holding steady at 58.1% with $85B daily volume indicates a balanced market without dramatic capital flight toward or away from alts.
